overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the press release was drafted by staff and the Board chair, and no quorum of either body took part in drafting or received it before release.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Select Board and Affordable Housing Trust deliberated outside a posted meeting to draft a press release about a housing development project.
allegations.key_passage: As such, where a quorum of Board or Trust members did not participate in the drafting of the press release and the press release was not distributed to a quorum of the Board or Trust prior to its release, we find that there was no improper deliberation.
